name: Yukino Chiaki
source:
A third year high school student who lives in Akatsuki Town.
Because he is a mature honor student he doesn't stand out much.
He's an unexpected person that the protagonist and her team would meet but...

[spoiler] His real name is Hiiragi Mine. [spoiler]
